description: Configuration schema for Consilium commit message generator. Supports YAML (.csl.yaml) and TOML (.csl.toml) formats.

$id.description: Optional identifier for this config document. Permitted so a config file may carry an $id without violating the schema

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON schema, enabling editor validation and autocomplete in the config file

exclude_diff_patterns.description: Additional file patterns to exclude from the diff sent to the LLM. Appended to the built-in lock file list. Useful for excluding generated files from LLM context

exclude_lock_files.description: Exclude lock file diffs from the prompt to save tokens. Lock file names and line counts are still shown, but their diff content is excluded (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, go.sum, etc.)

include_stats_in_prompt.description: Include diff statistics (file counts and line changes) in the LLM prompt to help it understand the scope of changes

max_subject_length.description: Maximum subject line length in characters. Follows conventional commits recommendation of 50-72 characters

require_body.description: Require body in commit messages. When true, commits must include a body section after the subject line

require_scope.description: Require scope in commit messages. When true, commits must include scope: type(scope): description

scope.description: Configure how scopes are validated. NOTE: If commit.validation.pattern is defined with scope regex, commit.scope.mode = 'regex' will be ignored (warning shown)

allowed.description: Allowed scopes list (used when mode = 'allowed-list'). Scope must be one of these values

mappings.description: Monorepo path mappings for automatic scope detection. Maps file path prefixes to scope names. When files in these paths are changed, the corresponding scope is suggested

mode.description: Validation mode: 'none' (no validation), 'regex' (must match pattern), 'allowed-list' (must be in allowed list), 'file-path' (use path mappings for scope detection). Note: mappings work regardless of mode (detection vs validation are separate)

nested_scopes.description: Enable nested scope detection for monorepos. When true, the first subdirectory after a mapped path is appended to the base scope (e.g. mapping 'packages/api' + file 'packages/api/core/x.go' -> scope 'api/core'). When false, only the base scope is used

pattern.description: Regex pattern for scope validation (used when mode = 'regex'). Default pattern allows lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens

show_excluded_files.description: Show a 'Lock files (excluded from diff)' section listing excluded file stats. When false, excluded files are completely invisible in the prompt. Only applies when exclude_lock_files is true

show_header.description: Show header when generating commit messages. Set to false when using prepare-commit-msg hook to avoid extra output in editor

types.description: Define which commit types are allowed. If omitted, all conventional commit types are allowed

description.description: Description of what this commit type represents

enabled.description: Whether this commit type is enabled

name.description: Commit type name (e.g., feat, fix, docs)

validation.description: Full regex pattern for commit message validation. When enabled, this takes priority over granular configs. MUTUAL EXCLUSIVITY: validation.pattern + scope.regex = CONFLICT (warning, pattern wins), validation.pattern + scope.allowed-list = OK (both used)

pattern.description: Full regex pattern covering entire commit message format. Default pattern follows semantic-release conventions

context.description: Project context configuration. Run 'csl context build' to analyze and cache project information for better commit messages

enabled.description: Automatically include cached project context (README summary, tech stack, structure) in prompts. Requires running 'csl context build' first

include.description: Include additional config files based on git directory. Similar to Git's includeIf directive. Later configs override earlier ones (scalars), replace arrays

path.description: Path to config file to include (supports ~ expansion). File must exist

when.description: Condition: Include when in this git directory (supports ~ expansion). Format: gitdir:path

api_key.description: API Key for api_key auth method. Use environment variable expansion to avoid committing secrets. Syntax: $VAR_NAME or ${VAR_NAME}. Examples: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, $OPENAI_API_KEY, $XAI_API_KEY, $GEMINI_API_KEY, $MISTRAL_API_KEY. Ollama doesn't need an API key

auth_method.description: Authentication method: 'api_key' (for anthropic, openai, grok, gemini, mistral), 'iam' (for bedrock only with AWS IAM/SSO)

aws_profile.description: AWS profile (optional, uses default if not specified). Useful when you have multiple AWS accounts/profiles. Must match profile name from: aws configure sso

aws_region.description: AWS region (required for Bedrock). Example: us-east-1, eu-west-1

claude_code_session.description: Session handling for the claude-code provider only. 'ephemeral' (default) runs 'claude -p --no-session-persistence' so commit generation never clutters your session history. Any other value sets the session display name ('claude -p -n <value>') for identification — it names sessions, it does not resume them.

effort.description: Reasoning effort level (Anthropic only). Sent as output_config.effort on the Messages API to control how much the model thinks and acts. Omit to use the provider default (Anthropic: high). 'max' requires Opus 4.6+; 'xhigh' requires Opus 4.7+. Sonnet 4.5 and Haiku 4.5 do not support effort and will return an API error.

examples.description: Control commit message examples shown to the LLM: 'none' (no examples, use with detailed prompt_preferences), 'default' (built-in conventional commit examples), 'custom' (load from examples_file)

examples_file.description: Path to a file containing custom commit message examples (used when examples = 'custom'). Separate each example with '---' on its own line. Supports ~ expansion

max_diff_size.description: Maximum diff size in bytes sent to the LLM. Increase to commit large changesets in one go. Very large diffs may impact response quality

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for LLM response. Most commit messages need 100-500 tokens. OpenAI reasoning models (gpt-5, o1, o3) may need 4096+ tokens

model.description: Model name (optional, uses provider default if not specified). See schema documentation for provider-specific model lists

prompt_preferences.description: Additional instructions for the LLM to customize commit message style. This is included in the prompt sent to the LLM. Use this to specify formatting, structure, or style preferences
examples:
Use this format:
<summary>

- List specific changes made
- Each change as a separate bullet point

prompt_template.description: Path to a text/template file that fully replaces the built-in prompt. Supports ~ expansion. Falls back to the built-in prompt if the file cannot be rendered

provider.description: LLM provider selection. Options: anthropic (Claude API), openai (GPT), ollama (local), grok (X.AI), gemini (Google API), gemini-cli (Google via OAuth token, GEMINI_CLI_TOKEN), claude-code (Claude via the Claude Code CLI, no API key), mistral (Mistral AI), bedrock (AWS)

temperature.description: Temperature for LLM generation. Lower (0.0-0.3) = More focused and deterministic, Medium (0.4-0.9) = Balanced creativity and consistency (recommended), Higher (1.0+) = More creative and varied output. Note: Temperature ranges vary by provider

stream.description: Streaming mode configuration. WARNING: streaming mode uses multiple API calls (3-5x cost)

mode.description: How to process diffs: 'spinner' (single API call with progress animation, fast and cheap) or 'streaming' (per-file review then synthesis, slower and more expensive, better UX for large diffs)

threshold.description: Minimum total changed lines (insertions + deletions) to activate streaming. Only used when mode = 'streaming'; smaller diffs use spinner mode

show_progress.description: Show a progress spinner during LLM generation. Automatically disabled in git hooks and when output is piped

theme.description: Color theme name for terminal output. Run 'csl theme list' to see all built-in themes

theme_path.description: Path to a custom theme JSON file. Overrides the theme setting if specified. Supports ~ expansion

title: Consilium Configuration
